capabilities: Export notes as paginated A4 PDFs with three presets (Formal Report, Snapshot, Compact Print)
Generate cover pages, tables of contents with real page numbers, headers, and footer page numbers
Collect and sanitize vault CSS so exported pages match Reading view styling
Repeat table headers across pages and control orphan/widow breaks
Export self-contained HTML as a fallback for browser printing
extras: Desktop-only (writes files via Node fs); falls back to self-contained HTML plus browser printing when silent print is unavailable. No network upload or telemetry; preset mockups are illustrative, not live screenshots.
intentEvidence: Not the built-in export that breaks pages, warps styles, and feels unfinished.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF export breaks pages, clips charts, drifts from Reading view styles, and offers no formal document structure like covers or page numbers.

relations.evidence: Paged.js engine; table headers repeat across pages; orphan/widow control
Not the built-in export that breaks pages, warps styles, and feels unfinished.

summary: PDF export plugin that paginates notes into formal A4 documents with cover, table of contents, running headers, and page numbers via Paged.js.
